summary: The AES hasher omitted input length, allowing differently sized, null-padded inputs to produce identical zero-extended blocks and collide. The fix mixes the original length into both halves of an additional AES round. This reversal removes that round from the implementation exercised by the existing padding regression test, whose assertions were updated by the fix. The test requires an AES-capable x86/x86_64 target with target-feature=+aes. No tests were executed.
